# AgentScout

> AgentScout is a curated directory of 567 AI agent tools for builders and ready-to-use products. Facts are verified; pricing is as makers state it.

Site: https://agentscouthq.com/
X: https://x.com/AgentScoutHQ
Contact: agentscout@mail.grokbot.com

- [tools.json](https://agentscouthq.com/tools.json): full catalog

## Recently added
- [All new tools, last 30 days](https://agentscouthq.com/new.html)

- [TradeOS AI](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/tradeos-ai.html) (added 2026-10-16): Build AI trading agents from your own technical-analysis rules that monitor markets 24/7 and flag setups (stocks, forex, commodities; crypto secondary).
- [Slash](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/slash.html) (added 2026-10-16): Business-banking MCP server that lets AI agents create cards, set spend limits and send payments, including stablecoins.
- [Payman](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/payman.html) (added 2026-10-16): AI agents for banks and credit unions that execute real banking payments and transfers under institution-set controls.
- [Dungeon Alchemist](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/dungeon-alchemist.html) (added 2026-10-16): AI-assisted map maker that builds detailed 3D battle maps for tabletop RPGs, for play on screen or printed.
- [Friends & Fables](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/friends-fables.html) (added 2026-10-16): AI game master for tabletop-style RPGs that plays with groups on Discord and the web, tracking characters, rules and world lore.
- [Open Dungeon Master](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/open-dungeon-master.html) (added 2026-10-16): Free multiplayer D&D 5e app with app-enforced rules, where an AI or human runs the table using a local model, API key or CLI agent.
- [Lorekeeper](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/lorekeeper.html) (added 2026-10-16): Voiced AI game master that narrates tabletop RPG adventures aloud, rolls dice and keeps a running campaign for solo or group play.
- [Questwright](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/questwright.html) (added 2026-10-16): AI dungeon master for tabletop RPGs that runs D&D 5e campaigns with dice, combat, battle maps and NPC memory, solo or with friends.
- [Astrocade](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/astrocade.html) (added 2026-10-16): Make and play small games by describing them to AI, then share them with a community of players.
- [Scenario](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/scenario.html) (added 2026-10-16): Generates consistent game art, sprites, textures and 3D assets from models trained on your own style.
- [Ludo.ai](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/ludo-ai.html) (added 2026-10-16): AI assistant for game designers: market research, concept ideas, game design docs and asset generation.
- [Suck Up!](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/suck-up.html) (added 2026-10-16): Party game where you play a vampire who has to talk your way past AI-voiced residents to get invited inside.
